mandatory_technical_requirements.quote:
Data governance
Canonical model management, schema versioning, lineage,
audit logs, data classification, retention, data residency, and
data portability.
Partner onboarding
Self-service documentation, API tokens, role-based access,
onboarding workflows, validation steps, dashboards, and
communication protocols.
Operations
Centralized monitoring, alerting, root-cause diagnostics,
runbooks, rollback, deployment governance, support model,
and service outage communication.
Security
Credential/secrets management, encryption in transit, least-
privilege administration, role-based controls, auditability, and
security protocol disclosure.
Implementation
Phased rollout, migration from legacy integrations,
coexistence approach, testing/UAT scripts, training,
knowledge transfer, and operating model transition.
value: Data governance: Canonical model management, schema versioning, lineage, audit logs, data classification, retention, data residency, and data portability.
Partner onboarding: Self-service documentation, API tokens, role-based access, onboarding workflows, validation steps, dashboards, and communication protocols.
Operations: Centralized monitoring, alerting, root-cause diagnostics, runbooks, rollback, deployment governance, support model, and service outage communication.
Security: Credential/secrets management, encryption in transit, least-privilege administration, role-based controls, auditability, and security protocol disclosure.
Implementation: Phased rollout, migration from legacy integrations, coexistence approach, testing/UAT scripts, training, knowledge transfer, and operating model transition.

evaluation_criteria.quote:
Proposals will be evaluated based on the following criteria:
Technical Evaluation Criteria
• Demonstrated understanding of this RFP
• Quality and clarity of the proposed approach and methodology
• Resource requirements, migration approach, and risk
• Validate RFP response claims through scripted scenarios, architecture review, security review, data model discussion, and operating model review.
• Feasibility of the proposed activity plan and timeline, and appropriateness of time allocated to delivering each task
• Relevant professional experience of the proposed vendor and implementation team
• Quality and relevance of the sample work, references, and case studies submitted

Financial Evaluation Criteria
• Quality and clarity of budget provided, and level of detail included
• Alignment of the budget to the activity timeline detailed in the technical proposal
• Assess license/subscription model, implementation cost, support costs, and overall value
• Adherence to the available budget
